auditFindings.finding: SEO health was 79/100 with a healthy technical foundation and no proven critical crawl or indexing blocker.
Median mobile Lighthouse performance was 56 and median LCP was 9.44 seconds across three lab trials; no field CWV evidence was available.
The posts hub contained 39 main-content words, the posts sitemap was empty, and no published editorial corpus existed.
Garden-suite, multiplex, borrower, and investor hub pages lacked the depth, review layer, source support, and internal-link paths present on the strongest pages.
All basic title, description, H1, heading-order, and duplication checks passed, but the site needed stronger contextual links between money pages, resources, and disclosures.
The server-rendered schema graph was strong, but the FinancialService entity lacked verified PostalAddress and GeoCoordinates and needed alignment with visible appointment/service details.
Technical AI discoverability signals were strong, but editorial depth, original assets, third-party entity corroboration, and GSC/Bing verification were missing or weak.
The first-visit consent panel covered authority proof and the application entry on a representative mobile viewport.

limitations: The PDF is a point-in-time audit, not live Search Console or Bing indexation evidence.
Performance findings are lab observations and must not be presented as field CWV data.
The 2026-07-16 live sitemap snapshot may supersede earlier URL-inventory assumptions but does not automatically supersede unrelated audit findings.
No OpenSEO or DataForSEO request was used to create this snapshot.
